qualification.en: The savings accounts are the part that lets public money follow the child. They start with some students, not every child. The cross-district line is still about public schools. Most of the page is phonics, letter grades, and tenure inside public schools.

quote: To give parents immediate options while traditional schools improve, Hilton will expand choice through ESAs, starting with low-income and special needs students.

sourceTitle.en: Steve Hilton for Governor 2026, “Making California’s Schools Work Again,” retrieved September 29, 2026. The page does not show a publication date.

summary.en: The schools page says he would launch education savings accounts, starting with low-income and special-needs students, and let parents use them while traditional schools change. The same page also says parents could move a child to a better-performing public school across district lines.
